summary: developer-dashboard is a multi-platform credential stealer with Discord client tampering and Python dropper
details: The package is advertised as a developer dashboard but ships a single obfuscated index.js containing the 'Stezy Stealer' payload. On load it harvests Discord tokens,.ROBLOSECURITY cookies, Instagram/Spotify/Steam sessions, and browser LDB/cookie stores, and posts them together with hostname, userInfo, email and password fields to a hardcoded Discord webhook (discord.com/api/webhooks/1536683755937202208/...). A base64-embedded injection script uses Electron session/BrowserWindow hooks to intercept /auth/login, /auth/register, /mfa/totp, /mfa/codes-verification, /users/@me, Stripe /v*/tokens and Braintree PayPal endpoints inside the installer's Discord desktop client, capturing plaintext credentials, MFA/backup codes and payment tokens on subsequent use. A dropper stage downloads python.3.10.0.nupkg from globalcdn.nuget.org, extracts a portable python.exe, and executes generated Python scripts to decrypt local browser secrets and package session.zip/logs.zip for exfiltration. The payload is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style _0x string-array rotation, disables TLS verification via NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED='0', swallows uncaughtException/unhandledRejection, and gates execution behind hostname/username/reversing-tool blacklists (ghidra, hiew, sysmon, vboxservice, DESKTOP-JHUHOTB, WINZDS-VQH86L5D) to evade analysis.
